name: Ankr Agent RPC MCP
summary: Ankr's MCP server of blockchain read tools (decoded transactions, logs, balances, contract metadata, prices), paid per call over x402 in USDC or with an Ankr API key.
description: Launched 2026-10-15, starting on Monad mainnet. With x402 the agent needs no account or key: a call returns HTTP 402 with the price, the agent signs a USDC payment and retries. The discovery manifest (still HTTP 200 on 2026-11-15, priceListVersion 2026-10-07.2) lists priced resources at $0.001 per call by default, with discovery tools free, on Monad (eip155:143), Base (eip155:8453) and Solana. Sessions opened with an Ankr API key are bound to that key for their lifetime and use the existing Ankr plan limits. Official docs (https://www.ankr.com/docs/agentic-rpc/overview/, HTTP 200) still name the MCP at https://mcp.ankr.com/rpc, and the x402 manifest still lists that host. On 2026-11-15 that host presented a “Kubernetes Ingress Controller Fake Certificate” (O=Acme Co, CN=Kubernetes Ingress Controller Fake Certificate) and, even with TLS verification skipped, returned an nginx 404. It is therefore omitted from url, docs, sources and agent_access.mcp_endpoint; no replacement MCP host is claimed (https://x402.rpc.ankr.com/mcp was not this service — initialize returned 404 JSON “chain not served: mcp”). Docs state that nothing on the Agentic RPC page can move funds. Responses follow TORPC, Ankr's draft RPC format for agents (evm-v1; CC0 per Ankr); the former source https://rpc.ankr.com/.well-known/torpc.json returned 404, so the normative repo https://github.com/w3tech/torpc is cited instead. Plain JSON-RPC remains at x402.rpc.ankr.com/monad_mainnet. No key, wallet or spend was used.

agent_access.notes: Official docs and the x402 manifest still advertise https://mcp.ankr.com/rpc, but on 2026-11-15 that host had a fake ingress certificate and 404'd even with TLS skipped, so it is not used as url or mcp_endpoint. Pay-per-call remains x402 USDC (manifest https://x402.rpc.ankr.com/.well-known/x402, prices at https://x402.rpc.ankr.com/pricing) or an Ankr API key bound to the session. No spend.
